summary: Euler shortcutting traverses a connected even-degree multigraph and keeps each vertex's first visit.
description: Input is undirected nonloop edge pairs and a start in the graph. Distinct parallel edges are allowed. Return a cycle order with its closing edge implicit.

Use a stack to splice closed trails and distinguish edges by index. Drop repeats from the reconstructed Euler walk. Disconnected or odd-degree input raises an error. The traversal is linear in the number of edges. Metric shortcut bounds are the caller's responsibility.
